scenarios.name: attacking-creature-gains-deathtouch
scenarios.why: 'Attacking creatures you control have deathtouch' is a static ability: while Ohran Frostfang attacks, it has deathtouch (from its own ability).

scenarios.name: nonattacker-does-not-gain-deathtouch
scenarios.why: The grant is only to attacking creatures: a second, non-attacking creature you control has no deathtouch.

scenarios.name: combat-damage-to-a-player-draws-a-card
scenarios.why: 'Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, draw a card': an unblocked attacker deals damage and its controller draws one card.
